nodes.community_name: 0132. Connections to GLUE Home are bounded: abandoned set-ups let go, failures said, reconnects paced
nodes.norm_label: adr 0132: connections to glue home are bounded: abandoned set-ups let go, failures said, reconnects
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home had unbounded RTCPeerConnection creation leading to browser limits (500 max), causing connection failures when rows on screen retry every 1-15s. Decision: GLUE Home limits connections to 20 being set up at once, lets idle ones go after 30s, website backs off reconnect attempts to 5-60s for background tasks.

nodes.rationale: A failed request to GLUE Home was dropping the direct link when it didn't answer within 1.5s. The browser was then opening a remote session to this computer's GLUE Home (counted against session limit) when analysis load slowed responses. Solution: never open remote session to own computer, let own browser in always (not counted), and only drop link after two failed checks (3s then 5s).
